title: Evolving with Open Worlds: Towards Recursive Self-Improvement for Future Forecasting
abstract: arXiv:2610.29784v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Most contemporary artificial intelligence (AI) systems are released with frozen parameters and improve through external updates, whereas an ideal system would keep improving from its own experience, a capacity we call recursive self-improvement (RSI). Yet studying RSI requires an environment that is continuously changing, objectively verifiable, and naturally grounded, posing a fundamental challenge for agent evolution. Here we introduce DeepEvolve, a sustainable evolution agent system grounded in future event prediction, in which agents continuously interact with a dynamically evolving environment and improve by internalizing and externalizing the experience gained through these interactions. translated_title: 与开放世界共同演化：迈向未来预测的递归自我改进
translated_abstract: 当今大多数人工智能（AI）系统在发布时参数即被冻结，只能通过外部更新来改进；而理想的系统应能从自身经验中持续改进，我们将这种能力称为递归自我改进（RSI）。然而，研究RSI需要一个持续变化、可客观验证且自然扎根的环境，这给智能体演化带来了根本性挑战。在此，我们提出DeepEvolve，一个以未来事件预测为基础的可持续演化智能体系统，其中智能体与动态演化的环境持续交互，并通过内化和外化这些交互中获得的经验来实现改进。一个“活的”环境负责合成可验证的任务，而递归演化引擎则将每次预测背后的推理轨迹重新转化为自身能力：通过将搜索与预测解耦，使参数级演化能够适应……
tldr: 提出DeepEvolve智能体系统，以未来事件预测作为持续变化且可验证的开放环境，通过递归演化引擎将预测背后的推理轨迹转化为能力，从而实现智能体的递归自我改进。
en_tdlr: DeepEvolve is a sustainable agent system grounded in verifiable future event prediction, achieving recursive self-improvement by continuously interacting with a dynamic open-world environment and converting each prediction's reasoning trajectory into new capabilities.
